primary_table: W_cell_density.csv if successfully retrieved and author-inferred abundance semantics documented; otherwise q05 retained as lower-bound output only and no primary abundance composition inferred
secondary_table: W_cell_density_q05.csv; each subtype is a marginal lower posterior abundance summary, its normalized ratios are only sensitivity scores, not posterior composition credible bounds
group_interpretation: Broad operational groupings of author-assigned reference labels; no new cell identity diagnosis, not uniform functional states. Confirm source taxonomy, particularly ambiguous proliferating and inflammatory labels; preserve individual subtype outputs.
regional_summary: For exacthex eligible near/far bands, report mean inferred subtype/group abundance per matched spot and relative group share=sum group abundance over matched spots divided sum all36 subtype abundances over those spots. Denominator excludes unmatched spots, with explicit numerator/denominator/missing coverage tables.
association: Report within-patient section pairs separately: L1 distance between regional group-share vectors and their far-minus-near differences; pair with broad-gene profile difference for the same patient and region. Any correlation among patients is descriptive, with actual independent N and no causal explained-fraction claim. Patient-level summaries precede resource summaries. Keep all subtype and patient outcomes.
sensitivity: q05-derived normalized group weights only as lower-summary sensitivity, not composition CI. Report primary-table missingness and compare common regional spot coverage; do not impute missing composition or extrapolate to GSE294385.
inference_limit: Same-RNA reference-based inference adds composition context; not new independent patients, matched protein validation, true cell counts or proof of a single coherent CAF state. No claim to resolve GSEPatient6 tissue identity from Val-only outputs.
